rule: integrator-approved B2 slice K under Lane C's conditions: declaration tag 12 (ConstParameter), parameter-slot tag 3 `3 | ty`, generic-argument tag 2 `2 | term`, const term `0 | ty | bits(16 B LE)` or `1 | slot`, each admitted only under body_nodes(). Terms are written in place at their single reference and read into one dense cold column. Bits are Constant's masked two's-complement target-width bits. A term's ty is an earlier primitive type row; a const parameter's type is an integer, bool or char

cases.note: `Tag::<3>::new()` instantiates the imported impl at N = 3, and `three()`'s Tag<3> unifies with the client's

`Mixed<const N, T>` and `impl<T, const N>` intern the same Parameter::index as a local definition: index 0 is N and index 1 is T in the struct; in the impl, the impl's own slots map through its self type. `wrap::<9>` passes a const argument to an imported generic function
i8 -1 travels as bits 0xFF; true as 1; 'z' as 0x7A
the imported bodies of `nine`, `five`, `rigid::<7>` and `forward::<4>` apply `wrap` and `Tag::new` with evaluated and rigid const arguments
the type argument `u8` in the const slot and `7` in the type slot are diagnosed as the local twin's are
`rigid::<7>()` is a Tag<7>, bound to Tag<6>
